cues.text: I've always secretly wanted to be a machine.
cues.en: I've always secretly wanted to be a machine.
cues.zh: 我背地裡總是希望自己是一臺機器。

cues.text: I felt like if I was a machine, I'd never let things fall through the cracks,
cues.en: I felt like if I was a machine, I'd never let things fall through the cracks,
cues.zh: 我覺得，如果我是機器， 我就永遠不會讓東西掉到 縫縫裡，我就不會健忘，

cues.text: I wouldn't forget things, and I'd do everything I needed to do on time every time.
cues.en: I wouldn't forget things, and I'd do everything I needed to do on time every time.

cues.text: I knew there were people out there that were like this, and I wanted to know what makes them tick.
cues.en: I knew there were people out there that were like this, and I wanted to know what makes them tick.
cues.zh: 我知道真有的像這樣的人存在， 而我想知道，是怎麼辦到的。 〔我們的工作之道〕

cues.text: So a few years ago, I started a newsletter called Super Organizers, where I profiled 50 of the top performers in a variety of fields.
cues.en: So a few years ago, I started a newsletter called Super Organizers, where I profiled 50 of the top performers in a variety of fields.
cues.zh: 幾年前，我創辦了 《超級組織者》電子報， 我在電子報中介紹 五十位各領域的佼佼者。 我和每十五分鐘就追蹤 每天做的每件事的經理談過，

cues.text: I've talked to managers who track everything they do in a day in 15-minute increments.
cues.en: I've talked to managers who track everything they do in a day in 15-minute increments.
cues.zh: 我和每十五分鐘就追蹤 每天做的每件事的經理談過， 我和用試算表記錄曾經 見過的每個人的投資者談過，

cues.text: I've talked to investors who keep spreadsheets of every single person they’ve ever met,
cues.en: I've talked to investors who keep spreadsheets of every single person they’ve ever met,

cues.text: and CEOs who keep their calendars basically empty and rarely ever do meetings, ever.
cues.en: and CEOs who keep their calendars basically empty and rarely ever do meetings, ever.

cues.text: I've also experimented with a lot of hacks myself to try to get me closer to my ideal.
cues.en: I've also experimented with a lot of hacks myself to try to get me closer to my ideal.
cues.zh: 我自己也嘗試過許多密訣， 想讓我更接近我的理想。 我在睡覺時用膠帶貼住嘴巴， 並盯著太陽燈增加我的能量。

cues.text: I've taped my mouth shut while I'm sleeping and stared at a sunlamp to increase my energy levels.
cues.en: I've taped my mouth shut while I'm sleeping and stared at a sunlamp to increase my energy levels.

cues.text: I visualized my compassionate self and tried all sorts of supplements to hack my body chemistry.
cues.en: I visualized my compassionate self and tried all sorts of supplements to hack my body chemistry.

cues.zh: 但我想和大家分享我所有 探索過程中學到的訣竅。 成為機器的理想其實是個陷阱。

cues.text: The ideal of being a machine is actually a trap.
cues.en: The ideal of being a machine is actually a trap.
cues.zh: 成為機器的理想其實是個陷阱。 它會阻礙我們的生產力，因為它 讓我們看不見實際問題的根源。

cues.text: It gets in the way of our productivity because it makes us blind to the roots of our actual problems.
cues.en: It gets in the way of our productivity because it makes us blind to the roots of our actual problems.
cues.zh: 它會阻礙我們的生產力，因為它 讓我們看不見實際問題的根源。 我們不是機器， 我們是有情感的生物。

cues.text: We are not machines, we’re emotional beings.
cues.en: We are not machines, we’re emotional beings.
cues.zh: 我們不是機器， 我們是有情感的生物。 學習如何技巧性地 辨識並處理我們的情緒

cues.text: And learning to skillfully recognize and work with our emotions is the only way to actually be productive day-to-day.
cues.en: And learning to skillfully recognize and work with our emotions is the only way to actually be productive day-to-day.
